_comment: Public-safe synthetic scenarios for owner_history growth (canary ateles#1448). Each runs the REAL sign-off path against a store that models Neotoma's array reducer (union of the top-priority observations, repeats kept).

scenarios.why: the canary entity's shape: a 1023-entry history. Three lenses sign off, then each re-signs the same commit twice: the stored array grows by the three distinct events only, and no write carries more than its own entry
decisions read the history through the dispatcher's reader, which treats exact duplicates as one: 1023 stored entries are two distinct ones
a history written by a plain store() is lower priority and stops counting once a correction carries the field, so the FIRST correction carries it; the next nine sign-offs add only themselves
when the signed write cannot be made the log names the failure class, a fixed reason code and the payload size, and never the exception text, a header, a body or a path
the reason code distinguishes 'no key for this lens' from a helper fault
an HTTP 413 is reported as payload_too_large with the size that was sent, so a size limit is visible when it is the cause
